rawContent: I found the words to tell my #metoo story in the wake of allegations about #HarveyWeinstein in 2017.  Despite his conviction, power is still abused in our media industry and sexual harassment and assault remain. Those still suffering need support and to know they are not alone

@matthaig1 I realised that accountability exists to some extent. Two years after finding my voice and telling my #metoo story, #Weinstein has been convicted. Little steps to survivors regaining their voice

On #InternationalWomensDay, I’m so grateful to all the sisters who have supported me, loved me and kept me afloat, and I stand in solidarity with all those who have suffered, esp my fellow survivors of sexual abuse - please know you are not alone, not now or in the future #MeToo

23 years. Justice in some ways but I
wonder what length he will really serve and how much longer than that it takes some survivors of sexual assault to break free from the prison into which their perpetrators force them. #MeToo #HarveyWeinstein
Many thanks to @MrSimonWebster ans @CabinetOfHeed for publishing this little fiction, ‘Bulletproof’, which may resonate with some media colleagues #flashfiction #metoo
